install:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
uv sync --all-extras

# Terraform
if ! command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  TF_VER=1.9.8
  curl -fsSL "https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/${TF_VER}/terraform_${TF_VER}_linux_amd64.zip" -o /tmp/terraform.zip
  sudo unzip -o /tmp/terraform.zip -d /usr/local/bin
  rm -f /tmp/terraform.zip
fi

# gcloud SDK
if [ ! -x /opt/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud ]; then
  curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/downloads/google-cloud-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz -o /tmp/gcloud.tar.gz
  sudo tar -xzf /tmp/gcloud.tar.gz -C /opt
  rm -f /tmp/gcloud.tar.gz
fi

echo "Milestone 2 tools ready. Required secrets: GCP_PROJECT_ID, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON"
